text:
ashley-cs: FYI customer report — trying to redeem a promo that shows active in the dashboard but API returns invalid/expired. They pasted and typed manually, both fail.

jordan-customer (forwarded by ashley-cs): 'Using code SUMMÉR2026, checkout says "invalid code". Dashboard shows campaign active until 2026-09-30. Please advise.'

sam-ops: can you paste the exact request/response and the code bytes if possible? suspect normalization or encoding issue.

ashley-cs: curl we got from the client (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"code":"SUMMÉR2026","email":"jordan+trial@example.com"}'
```
Response: 400 {"error":"invalid_promo","message":"code not found"}

mike-platform: can you dump the promo row from the promo-service DB (just code column) and show hex bytes? there are cases where dashboard normalizes to NFC but the redemption path matches bytes literally.

ashley-cs: pulled both values for comparison. customer-submitted bytes (python repr): `b'SUMM\xcc\x81R2026'` (U+0045 + U+0301, decomposed)
dashboard-stored code bytes: `b'SUMM\xc3\x89R2026'` (U+00C9, precomposed)

julia-cs: aha — NFC vs NFD mismatch. UI when showing code displays visually identical character (É) but stores precomposed; customer input (copypaste from some editors/phones) used decomposed sequence. our equality check is byte-for-byte so redeem fails.

sam-ops: that explains why typing/paste doesn't help sometimes. quick mitigation: normalize incoming code with Unicode NFC before lookup, and add a migration to canonicalize stored codes.

mike-platform: created INF-1248: "promo-service: normalize incoming promo codes to NFC + make lookup normalization-tolerant". I'll push a small change to staging (redeemer normalizes both stored and input to NFC) and add unit tests for decomposition/composition. ETA for staging: ~2h.

julia-cs: for affected customers, we should issue manual credit and close the loop. I can grant one-time trial credit. Please provide list of impacted redemptions.

ashley-cs: done — credited jordan+trial@example.com with 30 USD trial credit (manual grant id: mg_20260317_001). billing-bot recorded the action. Customer confirmed redemption went through after we applied manual credit. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: Manual credit created: id=mg_20260317_001, amount=30.00, currency=USD, customer=jordan+trial@example.com, created_by=ashley-cs, reason="promo redemption failed due to unicode composition mismatch".

sam-ops: follow-ups: 1) patch in staging -> rollout to prod after smoke tests; 2) run a query to find promo rows containing non-ASCII combining marks and canonicalize (or insert alternate normalized variants) — INF-1249 created for migration; 3) update docs to mention normalization for partner engineers.

ashley-cs: let me know when prod patch is live so I can email the customer batch.

mike-platform: patch merged to staging, tests green. scheduling prod deploy for next maintenance window (in ~4h). will post here when done.

ashley-cs: thanks — closing this loop once prod deploy completes and migration runs.

julia-cs: suggested canned reply for CS: "We're sorry — your code failed due to a character encoding mismatch. We've credited your account and deployed a fix. Please try again or contact us if it persists."

sam-ops: noted. leaving thread open until prod deploy + migration complete.
